messages:
maria_cs: quick flag for QBR prep — Acadia showing a sharp embedding surge this week, could impact renewal if not addressed. tagging finops + enablement. :triangular_flag_on_post:

dan_finops: numbers pls (7d vs prior). well recommend throttle vs credit once we see delta.

maria_cs: copied snapshot:
```
7d embeds: 5.9M (prev 1.0M) -> +490%
avg tokens/day: 410k (prev 78k)
est monthly delta: +$38k
main routes: /embed-bulk (65%), /chat/realtime (20%), scheduled tasks (15%)
```
No embedding-specific alerts fired.

billing-bot: Alert: customer Acadia exceeded expected embedding baseline. Consider guardrails.

leo_onboard: I'll check for SDK changes or misbatched jobs. bulk unbatched calls are common culprit.

sam_success: propose: 1) temp per-route cap + alert, 2) enablement note with batching examples, 3) 20-30m customer sync to run remediation window.

dan_finops: applied temp cap: embed-bulk = 10rps; created alert at 2x baseline. estimated immediate monthly savings ~ $26k. Can offer one-time credit if they impact prod.

leo_onboard: drafting enablement note. snippet to recommend:
```
# prefer batching 200-400 items
batches = chunk(items, 300)
for b in batches:
  client.embed_batch(b)
```
Also suggest reuse cached vectors where possible.

maria_cs: actions: dan - keep cap + monitor (today), leo - send enablement note + examples (today), sam - run customer sync (EOD). I'll add a slide to QBR with cost delta and mitigation.

billing-bot: Cap applied on route embed-bulk=10rps. Monitoring for errors and will notify if throttles exceed 1% of requests.
